verdict.rationale: Natural-language commands are Copilot's primary interface. First-party docs cover typed and voice prompts across Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook. They also document NL queries over connected email, calendar and files ("Find my budget spreadsheet", "What's on my calendar for tomorrow?") and agentic NL-driven actions via Browse with Copilot and Cowork. One hands-on report shows that natural-language editing inside Word was limited (no tables, no search/replace, formatting lost), while another praises its cross-document retrieval. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the agentic Browse/Cowork actions, and reliable natural-language control of in-document editing operations.
